long_biography.plain_text:
Raised in Nunspeet, Beelen left technical school after two years and worked as a seaman. At seventeen he traded surplus produce for animal feed, then moved through staffing into demolition contracting. He established Beelen Groep in 1999 and added asbestos removal, containers and recycling plants, building a vertically connected model that recovered materials from construction waste. A partner bought his remaining shares in 2020.

His next platform, Larendael, shifted the operating focus to investment and property development. Beelen created Amsterdam Logistic Cityhub, a multi-storey last-mile facility, and pursued redevelopment of the former ADM shipyard as a campus for specialist shipbuilding and marine technology. The portfolio has since broadened into industrial land, participations and new food and leisure projects, while difficult waterfront sites and ground-up concepts remain its defining thread.
